newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Suncorp to list new property trust.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Suncorp to list new property trust.

text.p: Suncorp Insurance and Finance said it planned a listing of its new A$196 million Suncorp Property Trust which will acquire a half share in the Carindale regional business centre in suburban Brisbane.
A total of 70 million units will be issued at A$2.80 each with investors paying A$1 on application and the balance on June 30, 1999, Suncorp said in statement.
Suncorp Property Trust, underwritten by Ord Minnett Corporate Finance Ltd, will acquire its half interest in Carindale from Suncorp General Insurance for A$105 million, the company said.
Offers for units open on November 18 with trading expected to start before Christmas, Suncorp said.
